parameters.name: BusinessId
parameters.description: The ID of the workflow. You can call the [ListBusiness](~~173945~~) operation to query the ID of the workflow by name.

parameters.name: ChangeType
parameters.description:
The change type. Valid values: 
- 0: added.
- 1: updated.
- 2: deleted.

parameters.name: CommitFrom
parameters.description: The start date for the commit, in the format yyyy-MM-dd.

parameters.name: CommitTo
parameters.description: The end date for the commit (inclusive), in the format yyyy-MM-dd.

parameters.name: CommitUserId
parameters.description: The user ID of the committer.

parameters.name: FileIds
parameters.description: The list of file IDs to query.

parameters.name: FileType
parameters.description:
The code type of the file.

Different file types have different codes. For more information, see [DataWorks nodes](~~600169~~).
You can also call the [ListFileType](~~212428~~) operation to query the code type of a file.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the workspace configuration page to obtain the workspace ID.
